newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-US EAGLES GROUNDED BY NEATH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-US EAGLES GROUNDED BY NEATH.

text.p: Welsh club side Neath left the US Eagles with a host of problems ahead of their test against Wales when they thrashed them 39-15 on Saturday.

The United States, making a delayed start to their Welsh tour because of the weather, were outscored by six tries to two and rarely broke the advantage line until touching down in the 58th and 69th minutes.
Their kicking played into Neath's hands and emphasised the Americans' urgent need for match practice.
Coach Jack Clark said: "We look very much like a team that hasn't been assembled or played together since September. Maybe we even look like a team with a lot of players out of season."
However, the Eagles included seven men who have been with British clubs this season.
Neath never looked back after establishing a 27-3 halftime lead, although they lost some of their control in the last quarter after making four substitutions in the pack.
